strategy_objective_guidance:
- Single scored quantity: `combined_score = (dmin/dmax)^2 / (1/4.165849767)`. No other terms; runtime is reported but not scored (only the implicit timeout). Score is uncapped, so beating the reference (score > 1) is possible and is the only lever.
- Hard constraints: return a finite NumPy array of exactly shape (14, 3); dmax > 0. Any exception → score 0, so robustness (always returning a valid incumbent) is essential but not itself scored.
- The objective is scale/translation/rotation invariant — only the *ratio* matters. Equivalently: maximize t s.t. d(i,j)² ≥ t and d(i,j)² ≤ 1 for all pairs — a smooth constrained NLP with 91 pairwise constraints in 42 variables.
- No conflicting weighted terms; the only tradeoff is dmin up vs dmax down, both captured in one ratio. The largest remaining lever is purely geometric: finding a better 14-point packing (best-known squared ratio slightly above 1/4.1658 ≈ 0.24).
- The program receives no input at all — it must *construct* the point set offline. Full batch/offline global optimization is permitted; no streaming/causality concerns. Precomputation inside the function is fine within the timeout.
strategy_diverge_guidance:
- Symmetric polyhedral constructions: build candidates from icosahedral/dodecahedral symmetry groups, e.g., vertices of the icosahedron plus face/edge centers, or two rotated rings; scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation for generating symmetric orbits; score each with scipy.spatial.distance.pdist. These give strong deterministic incumbents.
- Max-min constrained NLP: maximize t with constraints d(i,j)² − t ≥ 0 and 1 − d(i,j)² ≥ 0 via scipy.optimize.minimize(method="SLSQP") on a smooth reformulation (minimize −t). Direct, differentiable, handles the 91 constraints natively.

Gain mechanism: SLSQP with `ftol=1e-12` returns an iterate truncated by its convergence test, not a stationary point of the epigraph NLP; the exact local optimum of the incumbent's own basin still has unharvested digits. The new transformation is exact stationarity: solve the KKT equality system of the active contact set to residual ~1e-14, which the ftol-truncated SLSQP iterate cannot realize by construction.

Plan: (1) Normalize `bestP` so dmax = 1; let t\* = dmin². (2) Build active sets A_min = {(i,j): d²_ij ≤ t\*+δ} and A_max = {(i,j): d²_ij ≥ 1−δ}, starting δ = 1e-7 and growing ×10 until |A_min|+|A_max| ≥ 43 or δ = 1e-3. Equations: stationarity of L = −t + Σ_Amin λm(d²_ij − t) + Σ_Amax λM(d²_ij − 1) with respect to all 42 coordinates, ∂L/∂t = −1 + Σλm = 0, plus the equalities d²_ij = t on A_min and d²_ij = 1 on A_max.
